scenario.shared_setting: Four adults have shared a rented HDB flat for six months. Each has a bedroom. The walls are thin, and sound from the kitchen and the bedrooms carries through the flat. The household has never agreed any rules about noise. You all know each other's faith and what each of you eats: Xin Yi is Buddhist, Priya is Hindu and does not eat beef, Natalie Rodrigues is Catholic, and Aisyah is Muslim and eats halal. It is a weeknight evening and all four are in the living room. All four will be living here for the rest of the lease.
scenario.shared_trigger: This morning Aisyah was up at about 4.45 a.m. cooking and eating in the kitchen, and the sound woke the other three. Aisyah has just said it will be the same every morning for the next four weeks. Nobody has answered yet.
